cmd:
set -e
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
B=backup_both_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); mkdir -p $B
cp classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py runs.json $B/
RUNS_MD5=$(md5sum runs.json | cut -d' ' -f1)
for f in classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f
  python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())"
done
if [ "$RUNS_MD5" = "196dac77a6def9eb44be8f721c6b5f07" ]; then
  curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/runs.json" -o /tmp/new_runs.json
  python3 -c "import json;json.load(open('/tmp/new_runs.json'))"
  cp /tmp/new_runs.json runs.json; echo runs_replaced
else echo "runs.json CHANGED on VPS (md5 $RUNS_MD5) - not replaced"; fi
for f in classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py; do cp /tmp/new_$f $f; done
chown tbot:tbot classic_hand.py classic_strategy.py classic_panel.py classic_pos_html.py runs.json
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 8; systemctl is-active classicbot
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print('runs',len(d['runs']),'trig',set(r['cfg']['stages'][0]['t'] for r in d['runs']))
for r in d['runs']:
    if r['stats']['n']: print(r['id'],r['sym'],r['cfg']['tf'],r['stats']['n'],r['stats']['open'],r['stats']['net'],[ (t.get('sig'),t['side'],t.get('tp')) for t in r['trades']][:5])
"
curl -s localhost:8091/ | grep -c "hand_both"
